files.clang++-20:
#!/bin/sh
# clang++ 20.1.8 (conda-forge, arm64) with the macOS SDK: the linker lpn-compile looks for by this name
[ -n "$SDKROOT" ] || export SDKROOT="$(/usr/bin/xcrun --show-sdk-path)"
exec /Users/rachittibrewal/ergodex-03/lpn-scratch/llvm20-env/bin/clang++ "$@"
